summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured its login sessions with soft and hard limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Verified the limits before and after restarting node1.
actions_performed: Created appworker with UID/GID 1001 and home directory /home/appworker.
Created /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with soft and hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256.
Verified the effective limits in fresh PAM login sessions.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed and configuration persisted.

evidence.requirement: appworker account exists with persistent resource-limit configuration
evidence.summary: Shows the account, home directory, file ownership and all four persistent limit entries.

evidence.requirement: Login sessions receive 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: A fresh appworker login reports soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256; /proc/self/limits confirms the kernel-applied values.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 1f2f19b4-530d-4401-86f1-aba03b9f5b65, and recovered account, files, and effective login limits.
